facts.fact: 埃莉一早冲进房间，问海伦娜是不是请了辛西娅当晚来吃饭。
海伦娜在镜前决定只谈调情与探索，绝不承诺。
罗温姑妈在饭桌上故意点出“朋友”二字。
facts.anchor: ‘Lady Burrows, it is a pleasant surprise to have you dining with us this evening. Helena never invites… friends… to dinner.’

facts.fact: 辛西娅对托马斯发火，宣告自己终于自由。
facts.anchor: ‘I am sick to death of men telling me what I can and cannot do. I have spent my entire life following other people’s orders. My husband is dead. I am finally free. I won’t be dictated to by anyone.’

facts.fact: 辛西娅说“永远不”时，雷电劈开天空。
罗温姑妈在心里断定辛西娅血脉里有魔法。
facts.anchor: She has power in her blood. Magic in her soul.

facts.fact: 拉克兰说不认识乔治·利珀特。
罗温姑妈最后断定辛西娅是女巫，有人封住了她的力量。
facts.anchor: She is a witch. Someone trapped her powers, but magic can’t stay bound forever.
